purpose: Gives the held stakeholder card everything it needs from GilbPlatform, inside the stakeholder card provider.
namedChanges: This unit is new composition code, not an extraction: it copies no line of GilbApp. It builds the host of `stakeholder-record-card` (`StakeholderRecordCardHost`) from `useStakeholderCardPlatform()` of `stakeholder-card-hosts-gilbplatform` and mounts it above the card (`HeldStakeholderCard`).

It exists apart from the provider so that the provider does not import `stakeholder-record-card`: the record card's own tests install the provider, and a provider that imported the card would be a dependency cycle.

`HeldStakeholderCard` draws the sentence "The MyNet profile address is not set, so this card is not drawn." and no card when `settings.mynetProfileUrl` was not given to the provider, because the card's own-card band (`own-card-state`) throws when no address is set. GilbApp built the address from the profile app's base address at module load.

test/ holds the master and platform fixtures of the provider's tests (`world.ts`, `support.ts`, `fixture*.ts`, `writableFields.ts`, `fakeSession.ts`, `memoryStorage.ts`), copied unchanged, and `heldWorld.ts` with the contact catalogue, which the held card's tests need; they are not shipped as source.

0.2.0: the host gives `renderLanguages` (`LanguageSection` of `language-section`, the slot's props as they are, no `renderCountrySearch`). New: `test/languagesWorld.ts`; `test/fixturePlatform.ts` gains a `DELETE /lws/r/<id>` route (a test fixture).

host.implementedBy: `createCardVocabularyHost` of the provider, with the platform's `persistVocabulary` when given
